contexts.text: All things whatever which are proper to man are compared to night, because they are of thick darkness.
Under Day, see this reference. AC 936, etc.
Faith from love is the lesser luminary, which dominates by night. AC 32.
To dominate in the night ()... By night is meant evil; and therefore... evils are called works of the night.
The Lord also calls... a state of no faith night, as in John... the night cometh when no man can work ().
Forty days and forty nights () = the duration of temptation, in which nights are anxieties.

The faith which precedes being not yet so conjoined with charity, is... called night. Faith is also called night, in the Word, because it receives its light from charity, as the moon does from the sun...
In that night there shall be two in one bed... (); here the last time is called night, because there is no faith, that is, no charity. AC 2353:5.
Night () = a state of shade. It is called a state of shade when it is not known whether there are apparent good and truth, or genuine good and truth. Explained.
Sirens, who are interior witches, are those who insidiate in the night time especially, and then try to infuse themselves into the interior thoughts and affections of the man...
The night which succeeds (the evening) is the last state, when there is no faith: it also = the Judgment.

In the night () = the last time, when (the Lord's Divine Human and Holy proceeding) are no longer acknowledged; (for) night = a time of darkness, when the things of light are no longer seen. The Angels did not come in the night, but in the evening;but as it is the men of Sodom who spoke... it is said in the night. For night, in the Word, = the time and state when there is no longer the light of truth, but merely falsity and evil; thus the last time and state, when there is the Judgment. Illustrated.
If anyone walk in the night, he stumbleth... (); where the night = falsity from evil... for as all the light of truth is from good, so all the night of falsity is from evil.
The night when no one can work = the time and state where there are evil and falsity. ( = falsity from evil. AC 6000:3.)

Because... when the sons of Israel went out from Egypt, there was represented the vastation of good and truth within the Church, and that nothing but evil and falsity reigned, it was commanded that they should go out at mid-night (); and it came to pass that at mid-night all the first-born of Egypt were slain (). And as those who are in good and truth... are guarded among falsities and evils... that night, relatively to them, is called a night of the watches of Jehovah ().
In that night () = when all things were in such great obscurity. AC 2465:4.
The, fourth state of the Church is like night: when this has come, there is fulness, or the end.
When there is no longer any good and truth, or, as is said, no faith... then the Church has come to its... night.
Sarah died = night as to the truths of faith... The last time of the Church, when all faith, that is, charity, has expired... in the Word is called night. 2910. AC 2912.
That thus He would emerge and rise again from the night which was with them. Signified.
Before the Lord is acknowledged, it is night, because He does not appear.
Bury thy dead = that thus they would emerge from the night... as to the goods and truths of faith. AC 2925. AC 2931. AC 2948. AC 2955. AC 2961.
The reason (the first-born were slain in the night) was that the night = the last state of the Church...

Jehovah appeared to him in that night... () = the Lord's perception concerning that obscurity... Night = a state of shade, or what is obscure. By this Obscure is signified the literal sense of the Word...
Thou disposest the darkness and it becomes night () = to moderate a state of obscurity; for the Angels have changes of state...
God came to Laban... in a dream by night () = the obscure perception of that good when left to itself... In a dream by night = what is obscure.
The cold (devoured me) in the night () = temptations... Night = a state of no faith or truth.

At mid-night there was a cry made () = the time which is the last of the old Church and the first of the new one. In the Word this time is called night, when it is treating of the state of the Church. AC 6000:4.

Each his dream in one night () = concerning the event which to them was in obscurity... Night = what is obscure. In the spiritual sense, night = a state of shade induced by falsity from evil; thus also what is obscure, namely, of the mind. The obscurity which is of night in the world is natural obscurity, but the obscurity which is of night in the other life is spiritual obscurity, (which) comes forth from the absence of the Sun of Heaven. Explained. AC 5233.

God spake to Israel in the visions of the night () = obscure revelation... for night = what is obscure; and obscurity in the spiritual sense is that truth does not appear. Night, also in the Word, = falsity from evil; for those who are in falsity from evil are in the obscurity of night; hence all in Hell are said to be in night...
That night = what is obscure, and also falsity. Illustrated.
To walk in the night = to live in falsity.

The last time of the Church is meant by night; for then nothing of truth is received, because they are not in good... hence the light of truth is absorbed and suffocated in what is dark... and this is signified by the night coming when no one can work. Such, also, is the time at this day.
In that night... two in one bed... Night, here, in like manner, = the last time of the old Church, and the first of the new one.

That the Lord was pleased to be taken in the night = that the Divine truth with them was in the obscurity of night, and that falsity from evil was in its place: and that Peter in that night denied the Lord thrice, also represented the last time of the Church, when the truth of faith is indeed taught, but is not believed; which time is night, because the Lord is then utterly denied in the hearts of men.

What of the night? What of the night?... The morning cometh, and also the night (). The morning = the Lord's Advent, (which) was when there was no longer any spiritual truth in the earth, which is the night.
The day when it should be not day, nor night () is when the Lord was born; for it was then evening: that is, the end of the representatives of the Church.
Vastations are said to take place in the night (), because then truth is obscured, and falsity enters.
Here, () it treats concerning the desolation of truth; night = falsity.
The dread of the night () = the falsities of evil which are from Hell. AC 9642:5.
No night there () = no falsity.
The visions of the night () = obscure revelation. (So also ).

But... in Heaven there is no night, but only evening... whereas in Hell there is night... The night, there, is torment; and through all the alternations (in Hell) the night dominates: it is only the variations of shade and of the darkness of night which present these alternations.
This is the morning which succeeds the night in the other life.
The dread of the night = the falsity which is hidden.
States of temptations, and of infestations, and also states of desolations, there, are evening and night...

With Spirits, when it is the state of evening and night, their thought is in a compulsory state; they are then compelled to think about the falsities which are being injected, and from this compulsion they cannot possibly loose themselves...
The whole of that night () = a state of obscure perception.

About the middle of the night () = when there was total devastation; (for) the middle of the night = when there is the densest thick darkness, that is, when there is mere falsity; for the night = a state of falsity; and the middle of it = the height of it.
But the state of these tends to night, which is casting down into Hell.
In that night () = when it is the damnation of the evil; (for) night = a state of the devastation of truth and good; thus damnation...

In that night () = their state of evil; (for) night = a state when there is nothing but evil and falsity... Hence by night is also signified the last time of the Church... By night, also, is signified total devastation; and likewise damnation. References. From these things it is evident that the state of those who are in Hell is called night; not that there is the thick darkness of night with them, for they see each other; but because the state of truth and good which is in the Heavens is called day; and hence the state of falsity and evil is called night; moreover there is thick darkness there when anything of light from Heaven inflows thither...

It came to pass in the middle of the night () = a state of mere falsity from evil; (for) the middle of the night = total devastation; that is, the privation of all good and truth, whence there is a state of mere falsity from evil.

Pharaoh arose in that night... () = that the damned... when they have been let into mere falsity from evil, would apperceive aversion and fear for those of the Spiritual Church; (for) night = a state of mere falsity from evil, and thence damnation... AC 7955.

A night of watches is this to Jehovah () = the presence of the Lord with those who are in truth and good, and with those who are in evil and thence in mere falsity. Explained... The presence of the Lord in what follows is described by the pillar... of a cloud by night...
This is that night of the watches of Jehovah () = flat then they are withheld from all falsity and evil.
And by night in a pillar of tiro to illuminate them () = that when there is a state of obscurity it is tempered by illustration from good. Explained.
When (in Heaven) it is evening and night, they have obscurity of the understanding; but this is tempered by the Lord by the good of love, as by a lire which illuminates...
It illuminated the night () = the illustration of the truth from good on the other side.
A pillar of fire by night = a state of the obscurity of truth tempered by illustration from good.

The whole night () = in the obscure state... By night is here meant that obscurity which follows immediately after temptations; for those who are delivered thence first come into what is obscure before they come into what is clear; for the falsities and evils injected by the Hells inhere for some time and are dissipated only successively. AC 8202.
The night () = the state then of man and of the Church, that they are in mere falsities from evil.
It is said the morning watch, because the night was divided into watches, of which the last of the night and the first of the day was the morning watch.
In Heaven there is not the night which there is in Hell.
Under Evening, see this reference. AC 8812:3.
The night in which Belshazzar was killed = a state of evil and falsity.
By night, or twilight, in the Word, is signified a state of love in obscurity... There is not night in Heaven, but twilight...

The fourth or last state of the Church is called night. But, when the Church is in its night, in which it is when it is no longer in love to God and in faith, then, from twilight, morning begins with another nation... AC 10134:9.
The morning cometh, and also the night = that although there is illumination with those who are of the new Church, there is night with those who are in the old one.
With the Angels (there is) night or twilight... When they are in a state of love in obscurity or in some coldness, then they have night, or rather the twilight before the morning.
Hero, () evening and night = the last times of the Church, when all things of love and faith have been destroyed.

Night corresponds to a state of no love and wisdom. But it is to be known that there is not a correspondence of night with the states of life of those who are in Heaven, but there is a correspondence of the twilight which is before the morning. The correspondence of night is with those who fire in Hell.
Night, in the Word, = the deprivation of love and wisdom. References.
So That he sees Divine truth as in night...
That the state of the world and of the Church before the Last Judgment was as evening and night... Explained.
When times are predicated of the Church... by night is meant its end.
What they build by day falls down in the night.
They serve Him day and night () = that they live constantly and faithfully according to the truths... which they receive from Him.

The day shone not for the third part of it, and the night in like manner () = that there was no longer any spiritual truth nor natural truth serviceable for doctrine and life from the Word with them... By the night not shining is meant that there was no light from the moon and stars... The Divine truth in the natural sense of the Word is like the light of the moon and stars in the night... These things are meant by day, and night, in the following passages. Illustrated. AE 527, Explained, Illustrated.
By being tormented day and night () is signified to be interiorly infested continually.

There shall be no night there () = no falsity of faith; for by night is signified what is opposite to light... Hence by night is signified that which is not from the good of love from the Lord; and this is falsity of faith. Illustrated. AR 940.
(They said) Arc they not works of the flesh and of the night?
That this last time of the Christian Church is the very night in which former Churches have set. General article. TCR 761, Illustrated.
That after this night there follows the morning... General article.
As the present Church in Christendom is the night...
In these passages, by evening, and night, is meant the last time of the Church. Illustrated.
Night = the last time of the Church...
In the nights my reins chastise me (). The nights = the state of man when falsities rise forth...
Night = the last time of the former Church...
Night = a state of no faith and charity.
Mid-night, when the cry arose () = the Last Judgment; and, in general, the last of man's life, when ho is being judged either to Heaven or to Hell.
Not to have rest day and night (), when said of the Divine Providence and guard of the Lord, ... = universally and perpetually...

The reason it is said that the moon and stars were made for dominion in the night, is that the night = the light of the natural man; for the light of this compared to the light of the spiritual man is like the light of night from the moon and stars compared to the light of day from the sun.
They serve Him day and night in His Temple = that they are constantly kept in truths in Heaven... Day and night = constantly and in every state. AE 478:3, Explained.
Night = Divine truth in shade.
They had laboured all the night, and had taken nothing, () = that nothing [is effected] from self or proprium; but all things from the Lord.
Natural light is signified by darkness and night ().
Night to you for vision () = that the understanding of falsity shall be instead of the understanding of truth.

As by darkness and by night is signified the lumen of the natural man, which is like night relatively to the light of the spiritual man... it is evident what is signified by, Thou disposest darkness that it may be night ().
The endeavour to destroy truths clandestinely is signified by, Arise, let us ascend in the night ().
With my soul have I desired Thee in the night () = the life which is not yet in the light of truth.
Days and nights = continually. Explained. AE 890.
Night = the light of truth such as is with men on earth; and also the light of truth such as is with those who are in the Heavens and in the earths under the Lord as a Moon...

The day = the state of their falsity; and the night, the state of evil; for, as to the thought man is in light, thus in day; and as to affection he is in obscurity or in night... Hence there was upon the Tent a cloud by day, and a fire by night...
That of each Church there have been four successive states or periods, (the last of which) is meant by night. General article.
But night does not overtake the man who suffers himself to be regenerated; for he walks in God, and thence is constantly in the day... Illustrated.
That in each Church the four changes of state have been consecutive... and the fourth has been its end; and then was its night, or consummation. General article.
But night and winter do not contribute to the stability of the world.
